notes.title: Update: change in graphics
notes.notes:
Hello! 

Pleased to present an update to the graphical fashion of the game. This is the first step in big changes. At the moment the screenshots demonstrate only one of the stages of development of the graphic part. We are planning even more effects of weather conditions and environments. 

What do you think? We are moving in the right direction?
